summary: Tantalum oxide was deposited using radical enhanced atomic layer deposition (REALD) with tantalum ethoxide and oxygen radicals. The films were grown at 150 and 250 °C on various substrates, showing good electrical and optical properties. The study investigated the effect of water as an additional oxidant and the impact of different pulsing sequences on film properties.
evidence: Tantalum oxide was deposited by radical enhanced atomic layer deposition using tantalum ethoxide and oxygen radicals. The films were deposited at 150 and 250 °C on glass, silicon, and platinum substrates. The effect of water as an additional oxidant was studied at 250 °C.
